selection: Freeze the best long-full readout and threshold using validation only before any confirmation document is prepared or evaluated.
controls: Frozen prior residual MLP64 and frozen prior full local-attention MLP64, each using its original fixed validation threshold.
primary: Long-full validation-selected readout, with its common five-profile validation threshold. Promotion status is reported; no test-based re-selection.
corpus_rule: First400 eligible source documents in pinned shard order; then first64 additional eligible sources with at least1024 actual body tokens, capped to exactly1024. No score-dependent sampling.
exclusion: All prior source lines, body/full-body SHA,192-token body-prefix SHA, and URLs. The64 full-length sources also exclude all400 general sources. Include any previously completed confirmation document keys if present.
protocol: Match original native C4 single/multi and up-to1024 long variants, normal system tag and all five roles. Score every content token. Full-length cohort has five native role versions per new document.
units: 464 unique source documents. The64 up-to1024 long variants are subsets of400, not extra independent samples. No new natural dialogue claim; exact/prefix/URL exclusion does not establish domain or semantic near-duplicate exclusion.
comparison: Same frozen native MXFP4 forward pass; residual16/20/24 and local attention16/20/24, pointwise readouts only.
bootstrap: 2000 paired source-document resamples within profile; include per-position long-full curves.
gallery: 12 fixed equally spaced general document IDs, all five role panels and each of the three frozen readouts; no selection by accuracy.
working_target: At least90% system precision,recall,and balanced accuracy per native profile, and inspect long-full tail separately; do not use class-imbalanced overall accuracy alone.
